content:
FLT has a few ⊗[ℤ]'s in and they're now broken without set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false because we get two Z\ZZ-actions on such a tensor product:

/--
error: Tactic `rfl` failed: The left-hand side
  TensorProduct.instSMul
is not definitionally equal to the right-hand side
  SubNegMonoid.toZSMul

⊢ TensorProduct.instSMul = SubNegMonoid.toZSMul
-/
#guard_msgs in
open scoped TensorProduct in
example : (TensorProduct.instSMul : SMul ℤ (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] ℝ)) =
    SubNegMonoid.toZSMul := by
  with_reducible_and_instances rfl

I am not really sure how one might go about fixing this. The issue is that
TensorProduct.instSMul : SMul R (M ⊗[R] N) but any abelian group gets an action of ℤ anyway. This didn't seem to matter before v4.29 but now here we are.

here is (from what i can tell) the relevant part of the trace (found with trace.Meta.isDefEq true):

trace

{
      smul := fun r =>
        ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux r)
              ⋯).1.1 } =?= {
      smul := fun x1 x2 => ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux x1) ⋯).1.1 x2 } ▼
  [] ❌️ fun r =>
        ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux r)
              ⋯).1.1 =?= fun x1 x2 => ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux x1) ⋯).1.1 x2 ▼
    [] ✅️ ℤ =?= ℤ
    [] ❌️ ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux r)
              ⋯).1.1 =?= fun x2 => ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux r) ⋯).1.1 x2 ▼
      [] ❌️ fun x2 =>
            ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux r) ⋯).1.1
              x2 =?= fun a => ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux r) ⋯).1.1 a ▼
        [] ❌️ ℚ ⊗[ℤ] ℝ =?= (addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).Quotient ▼
          [] ❌️ TensorProduct =?= @AddCon.Quotient

I.e. from what i can tell, lean runs into the issue of needing to unfold ℚ ⊗[ℤ] ℝ to (addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).Quotient and failing?

The issue is that docs#TensorProduct.instSMul is defined in a rather convoluted way and is of the form "r∙(m⊗n):=rm⊗nr\bullet (m\otimes n):=rm\otimes nr∙(m⊗n):=rm⊗n and now extend RRR-linearly" (see docs#TensorProduct.SMul.aux) and the instance coming from AddCommGroup is just "rx=x+x+x+...+x", so the definitions are totally different (edit: this appears to be incorrect)
but then why does this only fail at instance transparency?
that can't happen (afaict) when the definitions are totally different?

Kevin Buzzard said:

and the instance coming from AddCommGroup is just "rx=x+x+x+...+x", so the definitions are totally different.

in particular, i think that after unfolding you'll find that this is wrong?

in particular, the following snippet (which shows that trace indeed occurs) shows that after reducing with instance-implicit transparency, the smul instances seem to be defined very similarly, when putting the cursor after reduce:

code

import Mathlib

open scoped TensorProduct

/--
[Meta.isDefEq] ❌️ fun r =>
      ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux r)
            ⋯).1.1 =?= fun x1 x2 => ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux x1) ⋯).1.1 x2
  [Meta.isDefEq] ✅️ ℤ =?= ℤ
  [Meta.isDefEq] ❌️ ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux r)
            ⋯).1.1 =?= fun x2 => ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux r) ⋯).1.1 x2
    [Meta.isDefEq] ❌️ fun x2 =>
          ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux r) ⋯).1.1
            x2 =?= fun a => ((addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).lift (TensorProduct.SMul.aux r) ⋯).1.1 a
      [Meta.isDefEq] ❌️ ℚ ⊗[ℤ] ℝ =?= (addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).Quotient
        [Meta.isDefEq] ❌️ TensorProduct =?= @AddCon.Quotient
        [Meta.isDefEq.onFailure] ❌️ ℚ ⊗[ℤ] ℝ =?= (addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).Quotient
        [Meta.isDefEq.onFailure] ❌️ ℚ ⊗[ℤ] ℝ =?= (addConGen (TensorProduct.Eqv ℤ ℚ ℝ)).Quotient
-/
#guard_msgs (substring := true, trace) in
set_option trace.Meta.isDefEq true in
example : (TensorProduct.instSMul : SMul ℤ (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] ℝ)) =
    SubNegMonoid.toZSMul := by
  with_reducible_and_instances
  · reduce
    congr
    sorry
I think that there's an issue with how lift is being used here, I tried to fix this in a branch somewhere, let me try to find it
The branch does fix the issue, I still need to work out exactly why though

So the issue is that TensorProduct.leftHasSMul is implicit_reducible (because it's an instance), but isn't type correct at implicit reducibility. I think using TensorProduct.liftAddHom to define smul should work and there's a TODO to do that, so I'll create a PR to see whether there's still performance issues with doing that tomorrow.
